title: 軌道幾何動態檢測
summary: 軌道幾何動態檢測以「動態幾何量測取樣基準與事件定位」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。動態軌道幾何檢測把車載慣性與相對位移轉為沿線幾何，速度、濾波及定位誤差會影響結果，單次超標需能回到明確里程與原始訊號。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。
summaryEn: This course develops dynamic geometry sampling datums and event location through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. Dynamic geometry inspection converts onboard inertia and relative displacement into track geometry; speed, filtering and localization affect results, and an exceedance must be traceable to chainage and raw signals. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為跨單元的原創假想工作表。先用第一單元定義邊界與單位，再以第二單元檢查另一個控制量，最後用第三單元提出前兩式未涵蓋的另一個檢查問題。原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：v=50 m/s, fs=1000 Hz；y=v/fs=0.05 m。只把 v 增加百分之十，y=0.055 m。模型邊界：車速與取樣率固定；點距不是完整量測系統的空間解析能力；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：dx=0.05 m；y=2*dx=0.1 m。只把 dx 增加百分之十，y=0.11 m。模型邊界：均勻取樣且帶限訊號；兩倍點距是理論界限而非準確重建保證；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。把兩個算例的單一輸入敏感度放在同一張決策表，說明哪個變化最值得先量測；不可把不同物理量的裸數字直接比較，也不可把任一結果當成實際設備的設計、施工或營運許可。
workedExample.textEn: This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: v=50 m/s, fs=1000 Hz; y=v/fs=0.05 m. Increasing only v with a ten-percent increase gives y=0.055 m. Boundary: Speed and acquisition rate are constant; point spacing is not the full system's spatial resolving power; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: dx=0.05 m; y=2*dx=0.1 m. Increasing only dx with a ten-percent increase gives y=0.11 m. Boundary: Uniform sampling and a band-limited signal; twice the spacing is a theoretical boundary, not guaranteed accurate reconstruction; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 取樣空間解析度與最低無混疊波長
stages.titleEn: Sampling spatial resolution & Minimum unaliased wavelength
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「取樣空間解析度」與「最低無混疊波長」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Sampling spatial resolution" and "Minimum unaliased wavelength": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 取樣空間解析度：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「取樣空間解析度」如何影響軌道幾何動態檢測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sampling spatial resolution” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Dynamic track-geometry inspection”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 同一時間取樣率在不同速度對應不同沿程解析度。本模型把 v 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 0.055 m。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。車速與取樣率固定；點距不是完整量測系統的空間解析能力。使用車速與逐筆時間戳作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；忽略加減速會造成不均勻空間取樣，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「取樣空間解析度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A fixed temporal sampling rate gives different spatial resolution at different speeds. In this model, v is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 0.055 m. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Speed and acquisition rate are constant; point spacing is not the full system's spatial resolving power. Use speed and per-sample timestamps as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Ignoring acceleration produces uneven spatial sampling; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Sampling spatial resolution” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: v=50 m/s, fs=1000 Hz; y=v/fs=0.05 m.

steps.title: 取樣空間解析度：定量估算
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「取樣空間解析度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sampling spatial resolution” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：v=50 m/s, fs=1000 Hz；y=v/fs=0.05 m。只把 v 增加百分之十，y=0.055 m。模型邊界：車速與取樣率固定；點距不是完整量測系統的空間解析能力；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: v=50 m/s, fs=1000 Hz; y=v/fs=0.05 m. Increasing only v with a ten-percent increase gives y=0.055 m. Boundary: Speed and acquisition rate are constant; point spacing is not the full system's spatial resolving power; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以車速與逐筆時間戳區分模型與觀察，先用每筆共同時鐘時間、速度及里程位置建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use speed and per-sample timestamps to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Sampling spatial resolution” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以車速與逐筆時間戳區分模型與觀察，先用每筆共同時鐘時間、速度及里程位置建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「取樣空間解析度」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use speed and per-sample timestamps to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using common-clock timestamps, speed and chainage for every sample, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Sampling spatial resolution. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.instruction: 超高差必須附帶量測基長才能定義扭轉。本模型把 dc 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 2.2 mm/m。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。兩端超高相減後除同一明確基長；不代表其他基長的扭轉。使用同一基長兩端超高作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；不同基長的扭轉值不可直接替代，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「局部扭轉估算」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Cant difference requires a measurement base to define twist. In this model, dc is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 2.2 mm/m. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Endpoint cant difference is divided by one defined base; twist over other bases is not represented.
